decisions.title: Goff Boulevard Roadway Improvements — Community Meeting Presentation
decisions.description: Preserves the 2013 public presentation for Goff Boulevard reconstruction, documenting project limits and funding, drainage-system design, roadway sections, the Sunset/Goff intersection, detention ponds, storm-drain connections, and neighborhood conditions before construction.
decisions.provenance_status: official County project page and byte-identical County-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 10-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final pages were rendered and visually reviewed.
Retained as the public planning and design record for a completed South Valley roadway project.

decisions.provenance_status: official County project page and byte-identical County-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative one-page PDF preserved without modification.
